dimension_evidence.diagnosis: Correct diagnosis must distinguish an absent value at a required Tensor schema position from a true optional null, explain why the eager undefined-tensor sentinel is type-bearing while an empty boxed value is not, and preserve the separate paths for present handles and scalar arguments.
dimension_evidence.localization: The public Prompt exposes the required-versus-optional schema behavior but names no source path, wrapper class, fallback generator, boxed-value type, nested conversion function, handle helper, or sentinel expression. The solver must trace schema-aware argument generation inside compiled fallback code.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: The repair must make null boxing conditional on the declared schema type rather than on the raw value alone. Two fail-to-pass schema layouts and three controls for optional tensors, present tensors, and non-tensor nulls reject global replacement of every null or bypassing boxed dispatch.
